arxiv-2007-14142.title: Rectangle Tiling Binary Arrays
arxiv-2007-14142.creator: Pratik Ghosal, Syed Mohammad Meesum, Katarzyna Paluch
arxiv-2007-14142.description: Abstract The problem of rectangle tiling binary arrays is defined as follows. Given an n × n n\times n array A A of zeros and ones and a natural number p p , our task is to partition A A into at most p p rectangular tiles, so that the maximal weight of a tile is minimized.

arxiv-2102-06413.title: Revisiting the flux tube spectrum of 3d SU ​ ( 2 ) \text{SU}(2) lattice gauge theory
arxiv-2102-06413.creator: Bastian B. Brandt
arxiv-2102-06413.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bastian B. Brandt. We perform a high precision measurement of the spectrum of the flux tube in three-dimensional SU ​ ( 2 ) \text{SU}(2) gauge theory at multiple lattice spacings. We compare the results at large q ​ q ¯ q\bar{q} separations R R to the spectrum predicted by the effective string theory, including the leading order boundary term with a non-universal coefficient.

arxiv-2210-13260.title: Almanac: Weak Lensing power spectra and map inference on the masked sphere
arxiv-2210-13260.creator: Arthur Loureiro 1,2,3, Lorne Whiteway 2, Elena Sellentin 4,5, Javier Silva Lafaurie 4,5, Andrew H. Jaffe 3, Alan F. Heavens 3
arxiv-2210-13260.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Arthur Loureiro 1,2,3, Lorne Whiteway 2, Elena Sellentin 4,5, Javier Silva Lafaurie 4,5, Andrew H. Jaffe 3, Alan F. Heavens 3. We present a field-based signal extraction of weak lensing from noisy observations on the curved and masked sky. We test the analysis on a simulated Euclid-like survey, using a Euclid-like mask and noise level.

arxiv-2310-00838.title: Spin-orbit enabled unconventional Stoner magnetism
arxiv-2310-00838.creator: Yue Yu 1 , Tatsuya Shishidou 1 , Shuntaro Sumita 2,3,4 , Michael Weinert 1 , and Daniel F. Agterberg 1
arxiv-2310-00838.description: Abstract The Stoner instability remains a cornerstone for understanding metallic ferromagnets. This instability captures the interplay of Coulomb repulsion, Pauli exclusion, and two-fold fermionic spin degeneracy. In materials with spin-orbit coupling, this fermionic spin is generalized to a two-fold degenerate pseudospin which is typically believed to have symmetry properties as spin.

arxiv-2404-15797.title: Optimal Experimental Design for Large-Scale Inverse Problems via Multi-PDE-constrained Optimization
arxiv-2404-15797.creator: Andrea Petrocchi, Matthias K. Scharrer, Franz Pichler, Stefan Volkwein
arxiv-2404-15797.description: Abstract Accurate parameter dependent electro-chemical numerical models for lithium-ion batteries are essential in industrial application. The exact parameters of each battery cell are unknown and a process of estimation is necessary to infer them. The parameter estimation generates an accurate model able to reproduce real cell data.

arxiv-2405-19297.title: Genuine Retrieval of the AGN Host Stellar Population (GRAHSP)
arxiv-2405-19297.creator: Johannes Buchner, Hattie Starck, Mara Salvato, Hagai Netzer, Zsofi Igo, Brivael Laloux, Antonis Georgakakis, Isabelle Gauger, Anna Olechowska, Nicolas Lopez, Suraj D Shankar, Junyao Li, Kirpal Nandra, Andrea Merloni
arxiv-2405-19297.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Johannes Buchner, Hattie Starck, Mara Salvato, Hagai Netzer, Zsofi Igo, Brivael Laloux, Antonis Georgakakis, Isabelle Gauger, Anna Olechowska, Nicolas Lopez, Suraj D Shankar, Junyao Li, Kirpal Nandra, Andrea Merloni. The assembly and co-evolution of super-massive black holes (SMBH) and their host galaxy stellar population is one of the key open questions in modern galaxy evolution. Observationally constraining this question is challenging.

arxiv-2601-02413.title: Minimal length: A source of quantum non-locality
arxiv-2601-02413.creator: H. Moradpour 1 , S. Jalalzadeh 2,3
arxiv-2601-02413.description: Abstract The narrow and subtle difference between the Hilbert spaces of operators corresponding to the purely quantum mechanical momentum and the generalized momentum that includes minimal length effects is polished. Additionally, the existence of complex numbers in quantum mechanics may be justifiable as a consequence of minimal length.

pmc-10623149.title: Development of a sensitive and inexpensive electrochemical sensor for indigotin using poly(valine) modified carbon paste electrode
pmc-10623149.creator: Kanthappa Bhimaraya, Jamballi G. Manjunatha, Hareesha Nagarajappa, Ammar M. Tighezza, Munirah D. Albaqami, Mika Sillanpää
pmc-10623149.description: In this study, an electro-polymerized valine (VLN) stimulated carbon paste electrode (CPE) was used to create a straightforward, inexpensive, and renewable electrochemical sensor for accurate and selective indigotin (IGN) determination. Comparing the CPE, to the modified electrode, it exhibits excellent sensibility for the IGN oxidation-reduction reaction.

pmc-11420806.title: Effect of Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccines on Viral Respiratory Infections: A Systematic Literature Review
pmc-11420806.creator: Ingrid T Sepúlveda-Pachón, Eileen M Dunne, Germaine Hanquet, Marc Baay, Sonia Menon, Luis Jodar, Bradford D Gessner, Christian Theilacker
pmc-11420806.description: BackgroundIn addition to preventing pneumococcal disease, emerging evidence indicates that pneumococcal conjugate vaccines (PCVs) might indirectly reduce viral respiratory tract infections (RTIs) by affecting pneumococcal-viral interactions.MethodsWe performed a systematic review of interventional and observational studies published during 2000–2022 on vaccine efficacy/adjusted effectiveness (VE) and overall effect of PCV7, PCV9, PCV10, or PCV13 against viral RTIs.

pmc-11639877.title: COVID-19 in Individuals with Severe Alpha 1-Antitrypsin Deficiency
pmc-11639877.creator: Hanan Tanash, Erona Tahiri Blakaj, Eeva Piitulainen, Suneela Zaigham
pmc-11639877.description: BackgroundThe risk of coronavirus (COVID-19) can be affected by the presence of certain chronic conditions. It is unknown if individuals with severe hereditary alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency (AATD) faced an increased risk of severe COVID-19 infection during the pandemic and if COPD in this population affected the risk of severe COVID-19 outcomes.

pmc-11675789.title: Giving Up the Guidelines: A Qualitative Evaluation of Disrupted Prescribing of Opioid Substitution Therapy in a Rural UK County During and Following the COVID-19 Pandemic
pmc-11675789.creator: Tim Lewington, Deanne Burch, Georges Petitjean, Roger E Thomas
pmc-11675789.description: The COVID-19 pandemic had wide impacts and repercussions for the NHS in the UK beyond the acute medical sector. This qualitative study evaluates the experience of medical (4) and non-medical prescribers (7) plus other staff (2 recovery workers; 2 community pharmacists) involved in opioid substitution therapy (OST) in a southern English county during and following the COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-12676123.title: Phylogenomic Analysis of Deep-Branching Telonemid
pmc-12676123.creator: Saelin Bjornson, Gordon Lax, Noriko Okamoto, Patrick J Keeling
pmc-12676123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The evolutionary history of eukaryotic supergroups has been investigated primarily by large-scale phylogenomics, but one major hindrance to continued progress is that some major eukaryotic groups have extremely sparse sampling. The phylum Telonemia is one such group. Environmental sampling shows two major subgroups of Telonemia, but there are only multigene phylogenomic data from three closely related species belonging to one of the subgroups, TEL1.

pmc-12838008.title: Integrative single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals immunomodulatory hub genes and candidate compounds for HIV-associated chronic inflammation
pmc-12838008.creator: Md Imran Hasan, Srinivas Mummidi, Ashley I Teufel
pmc-12838008.description: Despite significant advances in treatment and prevention, HIV remains a major global health challenge affecting millions worldwide. In this study, we developed a pipeline combining single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis with molecular modeling to identify potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets in HIV infection. Analysis of scRNA-seq data from individuals with HIV revealed 69 differentially expressed genes.
